title: Virtual Compute: refund assessment — payment remitted funds
content:
## Applicable basis

Virtual Compute refund assessment — Take the magnitude of the original posted payment allocated to the selected source.

Virtual Compute refund assessment — Subtract positive posted returns and earlier refunds linked to that original payment, excluding transactions belonging to another payment.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for refund assessment — payment remitted funds?**

Subtract positive posted returns and earlier refunds linked to that original payment, excluding transactions belonging to another payment.
